artworks.title: Job, 1st plate
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a man seated on a rock. His right arm is resting on the rock while his left arm is slightly bent with his hand on his thigh. The man has a beard, is bald on top with curly hair on the sides and back, and is wearing a draped garment. Next to him is a clay jug and what seems to be a hat or basket. In the background, there is a simple stone wall with sparse grass visible. The image is in monochrome with fine lines and shading.

artworks.title: Peasant Washing Her Feet (Paysanne se lavant les pieds)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a woman sitting beside a tree trunk in a landscape with hills in the background. She appears to be focused on her foot, surrounded by grass and flowers. A structure resembling a house can be seen, along with trees and a sky with cloud-like strokes. The scene is rendered in monochrome with a sepia tone, showcasing detailed etching work.

artworks.title: Woodcutter (Le bucheron)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a man chopping a log in a barren landscape. The horizon is low, showing a line of trees meeting the sky. The style is sketch-like with detailed lines. The color palette is black and white, highlighting the scene's starkness. Logs lie on the ground, some partially cut, with tree stumps around. A path with a log fence leads to more trees in the background.

artworks.title: Peasant Women of Boulogne (Paysannes des environs de Boulogne)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows three seated women from waist up. The woman on the left faces slightly downward, the central woman is in the middle, and the woman on the right is in profile. The woman on the left has closed eyes and wears a head covering and a cloak with a clasp. The woman in the middle has her face partially obscured and wears a similar bonnet. The woman on the right has a side view with a large head covering and a cloak. There is no visible jewelry. In the background, there is a simple room with a chair's back visible and shaded wall sections.

artworks.title: The Plow (La charrue)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a man using a pair of horses to plow a field. The artwork is drawn with precise lines and a monochrome color palette. The scene shows the man, horses, plow, and a tree in the distance.

artworks.title: Traveler taking Shelter (Le voyageur a l'abri)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a full-length view, standing and slightly hunched forward. One hand grips a cane, and the other grasps the coat in front of their body. The person's head is tilted downward, wearing a hat that obscures their facial features. The person wears a long coat with large sleeves. The background suggests an outdoor setting with lines indicating rain or wind. There is vegetation or shrubbery in the background and a tree trunk on the left.

artworks.title: Traveler taking Shelter (Le voyageur a l'abri)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing with a slight forward lean, holding a stick or cane with one hand. The person's facial features are shadowed, and they are wearing a hat partially covering their face. The person is dressed in a long coat. The background is dark and textured. There are no other visible objects or jewelry.

artworks.title: Fisherman with a Hoop-net (La peche a la truble)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on buff paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a forest using a long tool. Tall trees flank him on either side. The ground rises to a hill in the background. The artwork is detailed, with intricate lines showing leaves and foliage. The color scheme is monochromatic, dominated by shades of brown and beige, giving a rustic feel. The scene is filled with trees and foliage, with a distant hill visible.

artworks.title: Blind Beggar (Le mendiant aveugle)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated on the ground between two large trees. He is leaning slightly forward with his back against one tree, holding a hat in both hands. The man has a beard and short hair, wearing a jacket, shirt, and pants. Near him are crutches. The background includes trees and possibly a body of water in the distance.

artworks.title: Peasant Woman of Boulogne (Paysanne des environs de Boulogne dite La femme au panier)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a seated woman looking into a basket on her lap. She wears a bonnet and a cloak or dress, with detailed texture. The woman's face shows a calm expression, and she sits in front of a stone wall with contrasting light and shadows.

artworks.title: Peasant Woman of Boulogne (Paysanne des environs de Boulogne dite La femme au panier)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly woman in full body profile, seated upright. She has delicate facial features, deep-set eyes, and a slightly downturned mouth. She wears a dark cloak covering her entire body, and a cap that conceals her hair. She holds a woven basket in her hands, resting on her lap. The background is textured, possibly a stone wall, creating a sense of quiet and enclosure. The focus is solely on the woman with no other objects present.

artworks.title: Brick-works (La Briqueterie)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with a small rustic house and a structure on a hill in the center. The horizon is low, with the hill sloping towards the bottom left corner. The brushstrokes are loose and sketchy, creating texture and shadow. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of brown and dark sepia tones on aged paper. In the distance, to the right of the house, are a few leafless trees.

artworks.title: Landscape with Roller (Le paysage au rouleau)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image features a landscape viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is near the top of the image below the sky. A ferris wheel is visible on the horizon above trees. The brushstroke technique is evident in defining the terrain and foliage. A horse pulls a cylindrical object on a curved path. The scene is rendered in monochromatic tones emphasizing light and shadow, with varying intensities of black and white. Sloping hills and scattered trees frame the scene on the left side.

artworks.title: Landscape with Boat, 1st plate  (Le paysage au bateau)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape viewed from the water. A small rowing boat with three figures is in the foreground. Rolling hills with dense clusters of trees make up the horizon. The artwork features delicate and intricate brushstrokes, mainly using fine lines for texture and shading, typical of etchings. The color palette is monochromatic, using sepia tones for an antique look. There's a rectangular frame within the composition.

artworks.title: Landscape with Boat, 1st plate  (Le paysage au bateau)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a river or lake scene with a small boat containing three figures. In the background, there are hills, trees, and a cluster of buildings. The artwork uses cross-hatching for texture and has a monochromatic color palette of sepia or dark brown against a light background.

artworks.title: Landscape with Boat, 1st plate  (Le paysage au bateau)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: In this etching, the viewer's perspective is positioned above a water scene. Closest to us sits a small rowboat carrying four figures, two facing the front, one steering with an oar, and one figure seated at the rear. The horizon runs through the middle of the image, separating the water from the hilly landscape beyond. The right side of the horizon features gentle, sloping hills with trees. Further in the distance are structures blending into the surroundings. The scene is in monochromatic tones, using cross-hatching and parallel lines for depth. The trees are detailed with swirling strokes, while the water is depicted with horizontal lines for ripples. The overall palette consists of earthy tones in a rural setting.

artworks.title: Landscape with Pond (Le paysage a la mare)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with sloping terrain. Trees cluster around the center and extend to the right, obscuring the high horizon. Closest to us is a water pool with fine etchings for grass and reeds. A small house is near the trees to the right, depicted with wood texture strokes. To the left, more trees and distant land are visible. The etching style uses intricate line work to show texture and depth, with a monochrome palette for contrast and detail.

artworks.title: Landscape with Haystacks (Le paysage aux meules)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image displays a pastoral landscape with a tree on the left, textured bark and foliage. A pathway leads into the distance on the right, bordered by bushes and trees. In the middle ground are haystacks and a thatch-roofed dwelling. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of sepia and earth tones. Precise and flowing etching techniques are used, with varied line densities for depth, texture, and shadow.

artworks.title: Pollard Willows (Les saules tetards)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a bench at the bottom right corner, a tree with branches and leaves to the left, and a sky with a swirling effect dominating the upper half. The horizon is suggested by a band of lighter sky above a dark mass of trees or hills. The color palette is monochromatic with varying shades of dark and light tones.

artworks.title: The Hearth (Le foyer)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals in a dimly lit interior setting. The central figure is an older man engaged in conversation with the other two figures. To his left, a woman is sewing, and to his right, another man stands near a door. The room features heavy drapes and a light source, potentially from a fireplace or lamp. The setting is detailed with crosshatched lines.

artworks.title: Account Book (Le livre de comptes)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals standing side by side, leaning over a book. The person on the right has rugged features with what appears to be a beard and medium-length tousled hair, while the person on the left has a calm expression and is wearing a head covering. Both are dressed in dark clothing, with their hands near the book. The background is dark with horizontal lines on the right side.

artworks.title: The Bass Player (Le joueur de contre-basse)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a three-quarter view from the waist up. He is leaning forward and towards the side, reaching with his left hand towards a book on a table while his right hand holds the neck of a large string instrument, likely a cello or double bass. He has a full beard, his facial features are partially obscured as he looks down at the book, and his hair is neatly combed back. He is wearing a loose, long-sleeved shirt and the scene is monochromatic, in an etching style. The background is simple, focusing on the man and the objects in the foreground.

artworks.title: Viol Player (Le joueur de viole)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals. On the left, two figures are depicted from the knees up, standing with their hands crossed in front of them. Both have curly hair and similar facial features, with subtle and serene expressions. They appear to be wearing robes with high collars. The individual on the right, in profile, is depicted in a seated position playing a stringed instrument. This person, shown from the waist up, has slightly longer, wavy hair and a mustache. They are wearing a long-sleeved shirt with visible folds. In the background, there are several tree trunks with leaves. The scene is rendered with intricate crosshatching.

artworks.title: Death and the Woodcutter, 2nd plate (La Mort de le bucheron)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures in a wooded area. One figure is in a robe, standing with hands clasped, while the other figure is holding a bundle of sticks or branches. The background consists of tall trees. The drawing uses cross-hatching and fine lines to create texture and depth. The contrast between the background and the figures adds to the composition's tension. The scene conveys a sense of storytelling, with the environment contributing to the mood.
